Replying to @Kimberly I am so so sorry.  Getting scammed SUCKS and unfortunately there is no way to eliminate every single risk when sourcing overseas (or non overseas)  But there ARE things you can do to protect yourself and significantly reduce the chances of something going wrong. If you’re new to Alibaba, Trade Assurance + Verified Supplier should be two of the first filters you turn on. They are NOT the only things I look at when vetting suppliers BUT they’re a really good place to start with.  After 10+ years of buying on Alibaba, one of the biggest things I’ve learned is that sourcing safely isn’t about finding some magical “perfect” supplier… it’s about knowing what to look for, what questions to ask, and what protections to put in place BEFORE you send money. And that’s a skill you can learn. I have a FREE Sourcing for Beginners training where I break down the basics and help make this whole process feel a lot less overwhelming.
